# E010 -- Aludium Corporate Identity Manual

## Metadata
- **Company:** Aludium
- **Industry:** Manufacturing
- **Year:** 2016
- **Source file:** Corporate-Identity-Manual.pdf
- **Pages:** 22
- **Language:** EN
- **Pages sampled:** 1-2, 6-7, 12-13

## Brand Strategy
- Corporate Identity Manual V2.0, dated 15 March 2016
- CEO-endorsed (Arnaud de Weert) -- signals top-level brand commitment
- Brand defined as "emotional tie that binds all stakeholders" with emphasis on quality and consistency
- Contact: marketing@aludium.com for identity questions
- Headquartered in Alicante, Spain

## Logo
- Tagline: "premium aluminium"
- Multiple logo presentations:
  - 3-Colour PMS (primary)
  - 2-Colour PMS + 40% grayscale (for dark backgrounds)
  - 2-Colour PMS + white (for dark backgrounds)
  - Mono Colour PMS (1 PMS colour)
  - Grayscale (budget or legibility constraints)
  - Reversed/white (for colorful picture backgrounds)
- Logo is a fixed design element -- no editing or changes permitted
- Division sub-brands placed below horizontal logo with orange underline

## Typography
- Aller Light used for division names (observed on p.12)
- Calibri Regular used for email signatures at various sizes (12pt, 13pt, 15pt)
- Two-font approach: Aller (brand/display) + Calibri (office/communications)

## Color
- PMS-based color system
- PMS 289C (dark navy/blue) for division text
- PMS 1235C (orange) for division underline and accent elements
- At least 3 PMS colors in the full logo presentation

## Graphics
- Orange underline as division identifier -- simple, consistent graphic device
- "Round cap" specification on orange line -- attention to detail

## Photography
- Not covered in sampled pages

## Applications
- MS Outlook email signature: detailed specification including font sizes, content structure, and 4.5cm logo placement
- Uniform signature appearance mandated -- no background colors or images
- Division naming system for market segments (e.g., "transportation")

## Tone of Voice
- Professional, corporate tone observed in introduction
- CEO letter format establishes top-down brand ownership
- No dedicated TOV section observed in sampled pages

## Outliers
- PMS-only color specifications (no CMYK/RGB/HEX observed) -- very print-focused for a manufacturing company
- Division sub-branding system is well-structured for a multi-segment manufacturer
- Email signature gets a full page of specification -- shows operational focus
- Spanish headquarters but English-language manual
- V2.0 indicates iterative refinement

## Quality Score
- **Score: 3/5** -- Solid corporate identity manual focused on practical implementation (logo variants, email signatures, division branding). Good attention to production detail (PMS specs, round caps). Lacks photography, graphics system, tone of voice depth, and digital-first thinking. Typical of mid-2010s manufacturing CI manuals.
